result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1. The tests I ran pass.

**What changed**
- `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, the `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry of `CustomerAttributedRecords` (around line 5835): the exclusion was empty. It now excludes `CANCELLED`, the same way the per-quarter report already does. I also updated its doc comment, which said cancelled orders were counted.
- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`: added a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test that reproduces your example, plus a small helper that takes a status.

**Test results:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` (4 tests) and `CountryPurchaseOrdersTest` (4 tests) pass. I ran `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest` too, and the Maven run exited without errors.

**Side effect to check:** the per-country purchase-order report (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`) uses the same enum entry, so it also stops counting cancelled orders now. Its tests don't cover cancellation, so nothing failed. I left it this way because it is the same counting rule, but it is a change you didn't ask for. If you want the country report unchanged, I can split the entry so only the per-rep report excludes cancelled orders.

Nothing is committed.
